notes: Pinned proper-day fixture (Core #82/#87). Each row is a fixed-date proper feast the ICKSP calendar publishes at an elevated class, pinned to a specific civil year in which the feast is actually celebrated, with the class the Institute assigns it. The Institute's own calendar names its patrons — St Francis de Sales (Principal Patron), St Thomas Aquinas and St Benedict (Patrons of the Institute), St Thérèse of Lisieux (Patroness of the Missions) — and its apostolate ordos print each at the FIRST class (universal: third class). The pinned years match the dates on those published ordos: de Sales 2023-01-29, Thérèse 2024-10-03, Aquinas 2025-03-07, Benedict 2025-03-21. On the two Lenten dates the elevation is structurally decisive — under the universal calendar a III-class feast yields to the Lenten feria (only commemorated); the I-class elevation makes it the celebration. Uncopyrightable calendar facts only; the overlay only re-ranks existing universal feasts, so no Latin titles are stored. A NON-EXHAUSTIVE, well-attested subset — not the Institute's complete promulgated Proprium.
